William Ware (born March 27, 1976, in [Birmingham, Alabama ]]) was a gridiron football linebacker and  Running Backfor the Colorado Buffalos of the NCAA College Football League. Was injured in 1993 in a game versus Nebraska Cornhuskers.He suffered from two broken Knee Caps.
